title: Mobile applications
description: Use a developer-owned backend proxy for iOS, Android, and cross-platform apps.
---

# Mobile applications with backend proxies

Do not ship an Addis AI API key in a mobile binary. Mobile applications should authenticate to your backend, which enforces user permissions and calls the official Node.js or Python SDK.

```text
Mobile app → your authenticated API → Addis AI SDK → Addis AI API
```

Use short-lived user sessions, certificate/TLS validation, per-account quotas, and idempotency for voice generation. Treat rooted devices and decompiled applications as normal threat conditions.

Start with the [backend service pattern](/docs/build/backend).
